name: dig-loop
about: Reproduces #203 (the dig loop that freezes with marks left): Wolf's 2026-10-16 12.11 save (~/frostvein-saves/12-11-dig-loop.save, tick 7,640), patched by hand because the save format moved on: `"clearing": null` added to each dwarf and a top-level `"goals_completed": 0` (without them the load is refused with `missing field clearing`). No commands. Rots at the next save-format change: re-capture or patch it then.
